calls.price_at_call: Under $20 (as taped); PE ~8.3x; ~6.5% dividend yield; $0.31/share quarterly dividend
calls.thesis: BUY first tracked (first time covered on the channel). Smithfield Foods: packaged meats strong (5th straight year of $1B operating profit, ~$230M last quarter) but fresh-pork segment posted an $89M operating loss as hog prices fell; stock down ~15% YTD. Dividend looks safe ($1.18B cash generated last quarter; $0.31/share dividend re-declared late Oct) — get paid to wait for the pork cycle to turn. Bridget added SFD to her paper-trading watch list.
calls.base_case: Pork prices stabilise; dividend compounds via reinvestment while waiting for the cycle to turn.
calls.bull_case: Pork cycle turns and the stock re-rates on top of the ~6.5% dividend.
calls.bear_case: Pork prices fall further and the commodity segment keeps losing money; stock stays cheap.
